newsletter.subject: This week: miso squash soup
newsletter.text:
Hi friends!
This week's recipe is a miso squash soup that takes 45 minutes and feeds four. Roast the squash, blend it with white miso and ginger, and finish with toasted seeds.
Next week: a one-pan lemon chicken.
